For a gluten-free all-purpose flour substitute that maintains an airy structure, the best option is a high-quality 1:1 gluten-free baking flour blend. Look for blends that include xanthan gum or guar gum, as these binders mimic gluten’s elasticity and help trap air bubbles during rising. Popular brands like Bob’s Red Mill or King Arthur Measure for Measure work well. Avoid using single-flour substitutes like almond or coconut flour alone, as they lack the starch structure needed for a light, airy loaf.
